findings.evidence: `lift_eval_comp_map_dualMap` is proved by `rw [lift_comp_map]; rfl`. A grep for `eval.*comp.*dualMap` in mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dual finds no such lemma.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] Module.Dual.eval_comp_dualMap : Dual.eval R M z ∘ₗ f.dualMap = Dual.eval R N (f z)` (proof `rfl`) in a Dual file, and derive `lift_eval_comp_map_dualMap`/`lift_eval_map_dualMap` from it by simp.
findings.issue: `lift_comp_map`/`lift_map` are @[simp] and rewrite `lift (Dual.eval R M z) (map R f.dualMap p)` to `lift (Dual.eval R M z ∘ₗ f.dualMap) p`. No simp lemma reduces `Dual.eval R M z ∘ₗ f.dualMap`, so simp cannot reach `Dual.eval R N (f z)`, and `lift_eval_map_dualMap` could never be a simp lemma because its left side is not in simp normal form.
